info.title: PennyPost API
info.description: Canonical contract for customer-facing Transactional Emails, Marketing Emails, suppressions, webhooks, account introspection, and API-key management. Bearer auth uses pp_live_/pp_test_ keys unless an operation explicitly requires a pp_sess_ dashboard session. Test keys simulate delivery and mark rows mode:test. Browser signup, OAuth, domain setup, and general billing UI routes are documented separately because they are dashboard workflows, not SDK operations.

session.description: pp_sess_… dashboard session token; management and billing only, never email sending

mailgunBasic.description: Ghost/Mailgun compatibility only: username api, password a pp_live_ API key

from.description: Display name optional: 'Receipts <receipts@yourdomain.com>'. Domain must be verified for live keys.

cc.description: Carbon-copy recipients. to, cc, and bcc together allow at most 50.

SendEmailRequest.description: At least one of html or text is required.

suppressed.description: On the suppression list: reported, not sent, not charged.

quarantined.description: Present only while the account is restricted: sends to never-delivered recipients are held.

status.description: Terminal statuses win: a late delivery event never un-bounces.

first_send_at.description: Set once, on the first send ever (test or live). Powers setup checklists; never resets.

first_live_send_at.description: Set once, on the first live-mode send. Never resets.

properties.description: Custom fields. Usable as {{key}} template vars and in broadcast filters.
Replaces the whole map when present; null clears it.

format.description: How the body was composed. Bodies (html/text/source) ride only on single-broadcast responses, never lists.

source.description: Markdown source when format is markdown; round-trips into editors.

filter.description: Send only to contacts matching every condition, evaluated at send time.

source.description: Markdown body, rendered server-side at save. Required when format is markdown; html/text are then ignored.

data.description: One entry per batch item, in order. Each entry is exactly what POST /v1/emails returns for that item.

BroadcastFilter.description: One send-time condition. Conditions in a filter AND together against contact properties.

to.description: Where to deliver the rendered draft. Subject is prefixed [Test]; counters and billing are untouched.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Same key returns the same result instead of re-sending.

delete.summary: Delete an audience and its contacts

post.summary: Add up to 1,000 contacts without resurrecting opt-outs

patch.summary: Explicitly update or resubscribe one contact

post.description: Provide html or text. Their combined length must be at most 200,000 characters. scheduled_at must be in the future and no more than one year away.

post.summary: Cancel at the next chunk boundary

200.description: Plan, current subscribed contact count, contact limit, subscription id, and cancellation state

post.summary: Start a separate Marketing Emails subscription
Change the Marketing Emails contact tier
Cancel Marketing Emails at period end
Send one email to up to 50 recipients
post.description: One request is ONE message: everyone on the to line sees each other, cc and bcc work like a normal mail client, and all recipients share one provider message. To send each person their own copy, use POST /v1/emails/batch. Each recipient still gets its own log row, and suppressed recipients are removed from the envelope and reported.

get.summary: One email with its event timeline

post.summary: Send a signed webhook.test event to one endpoint

get.summary: Account status, plan, and enforcement state

post.summary: Create an API key (the raw key appears once, in this response)

422.description: Live keys need a verified domain.

get.summary: Check whether new free-account signup is open or waitlisted

post.summary: Send up to 100 emails in one request
post.description: The body is a raw JSON array of send objects. Validation is all-or-nothing: any invalid item rejects the whole batch, and the error names the item index. One Idempotency-Key covers the whole batch. Daily and monthly limits count the total recipients across all items, so a batch either clears them whole or returns 429 before anything sends.

502.description: send_failed: no item could be delivered

post.summary: Send a test copy of a marketing email
post.description: Delivers the rendered draft to up to 5 addresses with a [Test] subject prefix. Personalization runs with an empty contact, so {{name}} resolves blank and property vars stay literal. Never touches counters, claims, or billing.
